description: Get metadata without reading contents, like ls -ld: type, size (files) or entryCount (directories; secret files not counted), tokenEstimate, timestamps, permissions (readOnly on Windows), MIME type guessed from the extension, and symlink target. Also checks whether paths exist: each missing path gets its own NOT_FOUND entry.

path.description: Single file path; mutually exclusive with paths

paths.description: Array of file paths for batch mode (max 1000); mutually exclusive with path

items.description: File or directory path inside an allowed workspace root.

name: stat
title: Get File Info
